notes.note: Corrects the earlier station-runtime drop note, which wrongly said these claims were owned by uncited plugin routes or runtime-routes. The 'accepted mutation that still needs runtime reconciliation returns HTTP 202 with a configurationActivation receipt' claim depends on station-runtime.ts, which sets activation status 'pending' under AGENT_CONFIGURATION_ACTIVATION_DEADLINE_MS, and on routes/system/configuration-activation.ts, which maps pending to 202. The legacy copy into <STATION_HOME>/plugins/<name>/ also uses the plugin root that station-runtime.ts joins to the home. Restored the hub and added the route mapper.

Corrects the earlier station-runtime drop note: the 'named service' it relied on was not cited, so nothing covered the Lite telemetry paragraph. Identifier-free built-in Lite daily aggregates and the shown notice are usage-telemetry-service.ts; independent per-publisher sinks are telemetry-publisher-service.ts; plugin publishers defaulting Off with opt-in, and plugin Lite counts not being identifier-free, are stated and enforced in plugin-telemetry-service.ts; tier resolution (no identifying default) is the product-telemetry contract. The runtime hub only constructs these services.

Corrects the earlier station-runtime drop note, which cited an uncited instance registry. 'Direct command-station.js launches remain unfenced and can serve the same writable home as a registry claimant' depends on the direct runtime path in station-runtime.ts taking only acquireStationHomeRuntimeLease (no supervisor ownership fence), on station-home-lifecycle.ts, whose runtime lease lets multiple runtimes coexist, and on instance-registry.ts for claimant semantics. Restored the hub and added both shared owners.

The manifest caret range alone misses a resolved bump: the pattern names exact shipped content of Kontour UI (StatusBadge, Badge, Field and Select from @kontourai/ui/react; the --k-positive/caution/negative/active/neutral tokens, their -soft fills and the absence of a neutral soft fill; node_modules/@kontourai/ui/tokens/tokens.css). Added the version-keyed lock entry, which goes stale on any Kontour UI bump on purpose.

The guide states shipped Kontour UI token values (--k-text-md is 14px; --k-space-4 bounds the dock drag), which depend on the resolved release, not just the caret range in package.json. Added the version-keyed lock entry, which goes stale on any Kontour UI bump on purpose.

Corrects the earlier orchestration-route drop note, which said the scope statement was owned by uncited pairing scopes. 'The scope provides no general orchestration or terminal authority' depends on which routes accept home:transfer, granted at the PAIRING_SCOPE_HOME_TRANSFER rule in pairing-route-scopes.ts; the cited environment-security contract only defines the scope. Added that table.

The earlier station-runtime drop note attributed 'Only four metadata reads are auto-approved' to the example's agent.json, which the record did not cite. That list is the autoApprove array in examples/self-configuring-agent/agent.json, so it is added as the owner.
